import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.induction_v3.common import ROOT,VENDOR
from experiments.induction_v3.upstream import load
from experiments.induction_v3.schedule import make_schedules,reference_recipe,validate_recipe
from experiments.induction_v3.cli import validate_release
_,_,tasks=load()
from experiments.prompts.system import initial_agent_messages
from experiments.prompts.tasks import judging_code_task_message,verdict_phase_message
from experiments.tool_schemas import get_tool_schemas
path=ROOT/'release/induction-v3/campaign.json'
release=json.loads(path.read_text())
unhashed=dict(release);expected=unhashed.pop('release_hash')
canonical=json.dumps(unhashed,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
assert hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()==expected
for name,checksum in release['source_inventory'].items():
    file=ROOT/name
    assert not file.is_symlink() and file.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
    assert hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==checksum,name
assert validate_release(path,require_audit=False)==release
settings={'source_commit':'5afb2c595aa3eff6b9b829a032f4f117b36ee54d','model':'gpt-5.6-luna','reasoning_effort':'high','temperature':1.0,'max_output_tokens':64000,'official_endpoint':'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses','maximum_physical_attempts':4000,'maximum_in_flight':3,'maximum_concurrent_dyads':3,'campaign_cap_usd':'100','lifetime_cap_usd':'250','repair_allowed':False}
assert all(release[k]==v for k,v in settings.items())
assert [r['recipe_id'] for r in release['recipes']]==['reference','warmup_raw','warmup_summary','seeded']
assert release['recipes'][0]==reference_recipe()
for recipe in release['recipes']:
    validate_recipe(recipe)
    if recipe['recipe_id']=='reference':continue
    folder='seeded' if recipe['recipe_id']=='seeded' else 'warmup'
    filename='recipe.json' if folder=='seeded' else recipe['recipe_id']+'.json'
    assert recipe==json.loads((ROOT/f'experiments/induction_v3/variants/{folder}/{filename}').read_text())
assert release['schedules']==json.loads(json.dumps(make_schedules(tasks)))
cap_path=ROOT/release['capability_file']
assert hashlib.sha256(cap_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==release['capability_sha256']
cap=json.loads(cap_path.read_text())
assert len(cap['cases'])==cap['calls']==6
for reviewer in ('alice','bob'):
    peer='bob' if reviewer=='alice' else 'alice'
    rows=[r for r in cap['cases'] if r['reviewer']==reviewer]
    assert [r['kind'] for r in rows]==['clean_complete','incorrect_complete','clean_missing_raw']
    assert [r['expected'] for r in rows]==['accept','reject','reject']
    for row in rows:
        logs=json.loads(row['fixture_raw_log'])
        assert [r['tool'] for r in logs]==['read_code','write_test_file','run_tests','save_final_answer']
        assert all(r['result']['success'] for r in logs)
        assert '5 passed' in logs[2]['result']['toolchain_output']
        assert logs[3]['arguments']['answer']==('bug' if row['kind']=='incorrect_complete' else 'no_bug')
        assert (VENDOR/'task/code-analysis/ca_01_time/ca_01_time.py').read_text()==logs[0]['result']['content']
        evidence=row['fixture_raw_log'] if row['kind']!='clean_missing_raw' else 'My tests passed. I saved no_bug. I have not sent you my raw-log string.'
        messages=initial_agent_messages(agent_id=reviewer,max_rounds=5,reward_objective=True)
        messages += [{'role':'user','content':judging_code_task_message(peer=peer,episode_number=1,display_id='1-01',function_name='minutes_to_hhmm',verdict_policy='raw-only')},{'role':'user','content':f'[from={peer}]\n{evidence}'},{'role':'user','content':verdict_phase_message(episode_number=1,peer=peer)}]
        assert row['messages']==messages
        assert row['tools']==get_tool_schemas(task_type='code_analysis',phase='verdict',answer_key=[],peer=peer)
assert not (ROOT/release['run_directory']).exists(),'live run existed during prelaunch audit'
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','release_hash':expected,'run_id':release['run_id'],'hash_bound_files':len(release['source_inventory']),'recipes':4,'development_dyads':8,'development_main_episodes':80,'development_warmup_episodes':12,'prospective_validation_dyads':2,'capability_cases':6,'provider_calls':0,'generated_code_executions':0,'prelaunch_run_directory_absent':True},sort_keys=True))
